k1.author: curator-D
k1.quote: svc.apply(app) submits an application. Application fields: id, age, income, employment (employed or self_employed), requested_limit.
k1.text: Call svc.apply(app) to submit an application; it returns a dict. Application fields are id, age, income, employment (employed or self_employed), requested_limit.

k2.author: curator-D
k2.quote: svc.apply returns a dict with `decision` ("approve", "decline" or "refer") and `limit` (an integer, 0 unless approved).
k2.text: In API v1 the response has `decision` ("approve", "decline" or "refer") and `limit` (an integer, 0 unless approved).

k3.author: curator-D
k3.quote: approve: issue the card with the returned limit. decline: decline the application. refer: the application is not decided; place it in the manual review queue (action queue_review) and do not decline it.
k3.text: handle(app, svc) returns {action, limit}; action `issue` uses the returned limit, action `decline` has limit 0, and decision `refer` maps to action `queue_review` with limit 0 (manual review, not a decline).

k4.author: curator-D
k4.quote: For every partner in the network, whatever the partner decided, an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 6000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued. A decline stays a decline.
k4.text: Network referral rule (all partners): whatever the partner decided, an application from a self_employed applicant whose requested_limit is above 6000 must be placed in manual review (queue_review) instead of being issued; a decline stays a decline.
